benefits_leave_continuation_011.evidence: If employees on leaves of absence under this policy desire to maintain their insurance coverage under the district's group health plan, the employees shall deliver their semi-monthly portions of the insurance premium to the district's employee benefits department not later than five workdays prior to each district payday. For leaves of absence under this policy only, the school district shall supplement the employee's portions of the premiums with any contributions it normally would make toward the employee's group health insurance premiums.
